name: Startup Grind

sources.title: Startup membership application — application-based; tech-driven startups from MVP to Series A only; agencies/services rejected; working website mandatory

conditions: Application is free to submit but membership is vetted — 'Once you apply, our team will review your application and get back to you via email with next steps'
Accepted members get investor matching, mentorship, exposure opportunities, software discounts and a member-only Slack — there is no public self-serve directory listing
Whether accepted membership itself carries a fee is not stated on the application page
requirements: Tech-driven startup between MVP and Series A stage — agencies, consultancies, services and non-tech businesses 'are not a good fit and will not be considered'
A working website is mandatory to apply
Real founding team willing to participate in the community (mentorship, events, Slack)
preparation: Company stage, team and traction details for the application
Founder contact email for next-steps correspondence
workflow: Open https://startup.startupgrind.com/apply/ and complete the membership application
Wait for the team's review — next steps arrive by email
If accepted, complete whatever onboarding/membership step the email specifies
Value comes from the member Slack, events, mentorship and investor matching — not a public listing page
watchFor: Not a directory — acceptance does not automatically produce an indexable public profile page
The main startupgrind.com site is the events/chapter network; the startup application lives on the startup.startupgrind.com subdomain
Stage filter is explicit: pre-MVP idea-stage or post-Series A companies are outside scope
Do not pitch this as a backlink source — it is a vetted membership community
countsAsLive: An acceptance email with membership access (Slack invite / member account at startupgrind.com/accounts/login) — there is no public 'listed' state to verify
unknowns: Whether membership has a fee after acceptance
Application review time and acceptance rate
Whether any member directory/profile pages are publicly visible
